title: Covering a presentation
passage:
Who will present the sales forecast while Mina is away?
A. Her flight leaves on Tuesday. B. The report covers the next quarter. C. I've asked Daniel to take her place.
passageZh:
Mina 不在時，誰會報告銷售預測？
A. 她的班機星期二出發。
B. 這份報告涵蓋下一季。
C. 我已請 Daniel 代替她。
